**Indikator 2a** is a clinical quality indicator managed by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] that measures the proportion of ADHD assessment pathways for children aged 0–5 where the child is evaluated via clinical environmental observation within 120 days of the assessment's start [^src3]. It is a crucial metric for early diagnosis among toddlers, underpinned by the clinical guidelines from the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danish Multidisciplinary Psychiatric Groups (DMPGer)]] [^src5]. The indicator tracks the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] to ensure that evidence-based diagnostic methods are applied in the child's natural environment [^src4].

The indicator has a national development target of ≥90% [^src3]. However, it has consistently struggled to meet this standard, signaling a systemic challenge in early childhood ADHD diagnostics. In the most recent reporting period (April 1, 2024 – March 31, 2025), the national fulfillment rate was only 60% [^src3]. This follows previous periods where national performance was 59% in 2023/24 and 67% in 2022/23 [^src5]. 

There is profound geographical and institutional disparity in meeting the target. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] achieved the highest regional performance at 88%, while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] recorded the lowest at just 17% [^src5]. At the departmental level, a few clinics successfully achieved or neared the target, including [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] (100%), [[vejle-bup-ambulatorium|Vejle: Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] (100%), and [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] (86%) [^src5]. In the 2023 reporting period, [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] met the standard, while [[esbjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Esbjerg: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] failed to do so [^src6]. Conversely, private hospitals recorded a 0% fulfillment rate, with [[hejmdal-privathospital-viby-beh-afsnit|Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, beh.afsnit]] specifically noted for zero performance, highlighting a systemic issue with private actors in this diagnostic area [^src5].

Indikator 2a is part of a broader set of quality indicators that have undergone strategic revisions to improve clinical monitoring. Notably, [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] was split from what was previously a combined metric to separately track professional school observation or manualized diagnostic interviews for children over 6, ensuring both elements are properly evaluated [^src3]. The persistent low fulfillment of Indikator 2a and other process indicators reflects a broader systemic crisis in ADHD quality, emphasizing the need for better implementation of evidence-based methods and cross-sectoral collaboration across the Danish healthcare system [^src3].

## Claims
**Performance**
- Indikator 2a har et udviklingsmål på ≥ 90 %, men opnåede kun 60 % (95 % CI: 55–65) i perioden 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src1] (indikator-2a)
- Andelen af udredningsforløb blandt 0-5-årige, hvor barnet er vurderet ved klinisk miljøobservation senest 120 dage efter start af ADHD-udredning, er 60 % på landsplan [^src1] (indikator-2a)
- På landsplan blev der gennemført miljøobservation i 60 % af udredningsforløbene inden for tidsfristen for Indikator 2a [^src1] (indikator-2a)
- Region Sjælland ligger lavest med en andel på 17 % for Indikator 2a [^src1] (region-sjaelland, indikator-2a)
- Region Syddanmark opnåede 88 % for Indikator 2a [^src1] (region-syddanmark, indikator-2a)
- Der er to afdelinger der nåede udviklingsmålet for Indikator 2a: PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Vejle) og PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Aabenraa) begge med 100 % opfyldelse [^src1] (vejle-bup-ambulatorium, aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium, indikator-2a)
- Privathospitalerne opnåede en andel på 0 % for Indikator 2a [^src1] (privathospitaler, indikator-2a)

## Timeline
- 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025: Aktuel opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 1 og Indikator 2a (indikator-1, indikator-2a)
- 2023/24: Forrige opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 1 og Indikator 2a (indikator-1, indikator-2a)
- 2022/23: Tidligere opgørelsesperiode for Indikator 1 og Indikator 2a (indikator-1, indikator-2a)
- 2023/24: Referenceperiode for sammenligning af Indikator 2a og Indikator 2b, hvor 59 % og 49 % opnåedes på landsplan. (indikator-2a, indikator-2b)
- 2022/23: Referenceperiode for sammenligning af Indikator 2a og Indikator 2b, hvor 67 % og 43 % opnåedes på landsplan. (indikator-2a, indikator-2b)
